model_meta.description: Concept model of the claimed hoist drive and overload-prevention mechanism.

subsystems.description: Transmits rotating force to the load sheave; embodiment connects through reduction gearing.
Fixed to the drive shaft. Claim 1 states the pressing member presses this member via the reverse-rotation-preventing ring; the exact internal friction-member arrangement is not modeled here.
Rotates in only one direction with respect to the drive shaft and mediates pressing of the pressed member by the pressing member.

Screwed to the drive shaft so it can advance or retreat; presses the pressed member via the reverse-rotation-preventing ring. Carries triangular locking teeth with moderately inclined hoisting-up faces and sharply inclined hoisting-down faces. Has a large-diameter boss projecting toward the shaft tip and a smaller boss with a circumferential screw groove. The rotation drive member is rotatably fitted to the large boss.
Rotatably fitted to the large-diameter boss of the pressing member, facing it axially, with peripheral drive teeth and meshing locking teeth.

Interposed between the rotation drive member and urging means. Its inner engaged portion engages the large-boss engaging portion to inhibit circumferential relative rotation; its outer edge restricts axial movement of the rotation drive member. It transmits the disk-spring urging force toward the pressing member.
Fitted on the small-diameter boss nearer the axial tip than the rotation limiting member; presses the rotation drive member toward the pressing member via the rotation limiting member.
Screwed onto the small-diameter boss and positions the urging means relative to the pressing member.
Receives rotating force transmitted by the drive shaft.
Abstract identifies it as a source of rotating force for the rotation drive member.

item_flows.name: Chain-wheel rotation
item_flows.notes: Abstract identifies rotating force from chain wheel to rotation drive member.

item_flows.name: Hoisting drive rotation
item_flows.notes: Drive shaft transmits rotation to load sheave.

steps.description: The chain wheel supplies rotating force to the rotation drive member; its peripheral drive teeth receive this drive.
Meshing locking teeth transmit rotation from rotation drive member to pressing member; the pressing member presses the pressed member via the reverse-rotation-preventing ring.
The drive shaft transmits rotating force to the load sheave.
During hoisting-up overload, locking teeth can ride over their moderately inclined hoisting-up faces against the urging force.

During hoisting-down, the urging force prevents the locking teeth from riding over the sharply inclined hoisting-down faces. The rotation limiting member's keyed engagement inhibits circumferential rotation relative to the large boss while its outer edge restricts axial movement; overload rotation is not transmitted to the disk spring and nut.
